title: decimate
body:
## decimate

Reduces the triangle count of a polygonal surface by a target fraction (Schemaxis default 0.5) with vtkDecimatePro, trying to preserve shape; preserveTopology (Schemaxis default true) prevents holes and splits at the cost of possibly missing the target. Use it to lighten large surfaces for rendering or export. Input must be triangles; run triangulate first if other polygons are present.

Common mistakes and assumptions:

- Small features and sharp detail are lost first; compare with the original before measuring on the result.

Native constructor: `Decimate`. Identity: `curated binding`. Role: `pipeline`. Output kinds: `["data"]`.

### Inputs

| Port | Meaning / native port | Required | Multiplicity | Kind | Contract |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `input` | Required data input for the native Input port. Give the name of the upstream node to connect, or a {node, port} object to use another of its output ports. Accepted data: polygonal data (surfaces, lines or vertices) (vtkPolyData). | True | one object | `data` | `{"compatibility":"native-domain-checked","composite":null,"cost":{"basis":"no benchmark","conversion":"none inserted","rating":"unknown"},"nativeTypes":["vtkPolyData"],"requirements":{},"traits":{"contiguity":"unknown","indexing":"unknown","iteration":"unknown"}}` |

### Options

| Key | Meaning / native assignment | Type and constraints | Default / required | Example value |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `reduction` | This property specifies the desired reduction in the total number of polygons in the output dataset. For example, if the TargetReduction value is 0.9, the Decimate filter will attempt to produce an output dataset that is 10% the size of the input.) | `{"type":"number","minimum":0,"maximum":1}` | `0.5` | `0.5` |
| `preserveTopology` | If this property is set to 1, decimation will not split the dataset or produce holes, but it may keep the filter from reaching the reduction target. If it is set to 0, better reduction can occur (reaching the reduction target), but holes in the model may be produced. | `{"type":"boolean"}` | `true` | `true` |

Execution contract:

```json
{
  "mode": "serial",
  "performance": "unknown"
}
```

### Syntax example

Place in `nodes`. Data outputs may be selected by a scene; resource outputs must be connected to a compatible consumer.

```json
{
  "id": "result",
  "filter": "decimate",
  "inputs": {
    "input": "UPSTREAM_input"
  }
}
```
